from pathlib import Path
import textwrap
program = '''def transform(grid):
    """Fill each hollow square according to its side length parity."""
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque
    bg = Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = g[r][c]
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny, nx) not in seen and g[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y, x in cells), max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y, x in cells), max(x for y, x in cells)
            # A square frame encloses a square whose fill color alternates by side length.
            side = r1 - r0 + 1
            if side == c1 - c0 + 1 and side >= 3:
                if (len(cells) == 4 * side - 4 and
                    all(g[r0][x] == color and g[r1][x] == color for x in range(c0, c1 + 1)) and
                    all(g[y][c0] == color and g[y][c1] == color for y in range(r0, r1 + 1))):
                    fill = 7 if side % 2 else 2
                    for y in range(r0 + 1, r1):
                        for x in range(c0 + 1, c1):
                            if g[y][x] == bg:
                                g[y][x] = fill
    return g
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
print('saved', p)
